findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_cash_flow_sankey" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cash_flow_sankey, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: analyze_bank_csv · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cash_flow_sankey, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: analyze_bank_csv · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "analyze_bank_csv" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
